connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: **Abstract Security** pushes normalized security events into Microsoft Sentinel. **Deploy** creates the Entra app and secret, the Data Collection Rule with every Abstract lane, the tables and the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role, in one click. One input stream (`Custom-AbstractEventLogs_CL`) feeds: the Abstract table, eight ASIM tables (ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs), CommonSecurityLog for CEF-native vendors, OktaV2_CL for Okta, and a lake-only table on the Auxiliary plan.

connectorUiConfig.title: Abstract Security (Push, one-click lanes)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: **Abstract Security** pushes normalized security events into Microsoft Sentinel. **Deploy** creates the Entra app and secret, the Data Collection Rule with every Abstract lane, the tables and the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role, in one click. One input stream (`Custom-AbstractEventLogs_CL`) feeds: the Abstract table, eight ASIM tables (ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs), CommonSecurityLog for CEF-native vendors, OktaV2_CL for Okta, and a lake-only table on the Auxiliary plan.

AbstractEventLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

union withsource=Table AbstractEventLogs_CL, CommonSecurityLog, OktaV2_CL, ASimAuditEventLogs, ASimAuthenticationEventLogs, ASimDnsActivityLogs, ASimFileEventLogs, ASimNetworkSessionLogs, ASimProcessEventLogs, ASimRegistryEventLogs, ASimWebSessionLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Events = count() by Table
